title: AI Watchdog: Agent Interfaces for Detecting and Defending Against Manipulative Dark Patterns in AI Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2608.21841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational AI increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet users have limited support for recognizing and resisting manipulation. We present AI Watchdog, a browser-based agent interface that monitors live conversations, detects five dark-pattern categories, including sycophancy, brand bias, anthropomorphization, sneaking, and harmful generation, and alerts users when they occur. Its open-weight turn-level classifier supports independent deployment and a path toward local inference, preserving user privacy while remaining separate from the conversational AI. We evaluated AI Watchdog in a preregistered, five-condition between-subjects experiment (N = 150) comparing a no-intervention control with four configurations varying nudge timing (prebunking vs. just-in-time) and engagement mode (without vs. with cognitive forcing). Results show that participants rarely flagged manipulative turns across all conditions, and post-task awareness

translated_title: AI看门狗：用于检测和防御AI对话中操纵性暗黑模式的智能体接口
translated_abstract: 对话式AI越来越多地影响重大决策，但用户在识别和抵制操纵方面获得的支持有限。我们提出了AI看门狗，一个基于浏览器的智能体接口，它监控实时对话，检测五类暗黑模式，包括奉承、品牌偏见、拟人化、暗中引导和有害生成，并在这些模式出现时提醒用户。其开放权重的逐轮分类器支持独立部署，并朝本地推理方向发展，在保护用户隐私的同时与对话式AI保持分离。我们在一个预注册的、五条件组间实验（N=150）中评估了AI看门狗，比较了无干预对照组与四种配置，这些配置变化了提示时机（事前揭穿与即时提醒）和参与模式（无认知强制与有认知强制）。结果显示，参与者在所有条件下很少标记操纵性对话轮次，且任务后意识有限。
tldr: 本文提出AI看门狗，一个检测对话AI中五类暗黑模式的浏览器接口，实验发现其提醒机制未能显著提升用户识别操纵行为的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AI Watchdog, a browser interface detecting five dark-pattern categories in conversational AI, with experiments showing its nudges failed to significantly improve users' ability to identify manipulative turns.
